qualifiedNameEdgeCase.sourceHtml: DurableTaskExtensions.WaitAsync races the call, ground-quote/0, with a durable delay, ground-quote/1. The runtime records the delay’s due time, so a replay after a deactivation keeps the original deadline: the timeout counts from the first run. When the delay elapses first, the call receives a cancellation request with the reason The operation timed out after 00:02:00., and WaitAsync waits for the carrier’s outcome. A call which ends canceled throws TimeoutException, whose inner exception is the call’s OperationCanceledException; a quote which the carrier returns anyway is the result. When the call completes first, WaitAsync cancels the delay and returns the call’s result or throws its failure. WaitUntilAsync takes an absolute deadline instead.
